verdict.rationale: Parsec documents 'near-zero latency' streaming at up to 240 FPS (60 FPS at 4K) and interactive input including keyboard, mouse, gamepad and Wacom pressure/tilt. A community user confirms it is smooth enough to play games over 4G, which is clearly interactive use rather than passive viewing. However, no evidence explicitly states that the stream uses hardware encoding. missing for 10: first-party documentation of hardware (GPU) encoding, quantified latency figures or independent latency measurements.

support.subject: As a power user, the stream is hardware-encoded and low-latency enough for interactive work, not just passive viewing

citations.quote: a seamless 4k experience at up to 60 frames per second with near-zero latency

Full Wacom tablet support with pressure + tilt
